method.structure: Same weighted hierarchy + provenance-scoped offering pipeline. Base offering refit on training data; same base regularization and thresholds; prior strength selected within training-only inner family folds.
method.validation: Preserve original v8 family folds and base settings; new families assigned without labels. Matched v8-evidence control vs v9 candidate on identical test rows. Old control predictions reproduce original results on all original rows.
method.explanations: Stored as scoped metadata, not duplicated labels or arbitrary numeric strengths. Existing prior formulation unchanged to isolate evidence effects; no universal >=30 equality or >=10 dominance constraint added.
method.limits: Repeated adaptive nonrandom data; not fresh prospective validation. Equal-price classifier output need not imply exact fitted score equality except enforced pure-tare ties.
